title: Solved-LP1 dollar-segment operation-frame audit

target.description: Whether the six source dollar boundaries coincide with the six known operation changes across seven solved-LP1 segments

summary: The seven source dollar segments are operation-homogeneous, and their six boundaries exactly equal the six known operation-change gaps across the fifteen rune-bearing solved LP1 pages.
why_run: To test whether dollar segmentation is an authored operation-frame boundary on known solved material before applying that runtime model to unsolved LP2 segments.

pipeline.description: Reconstruct the page-method sequence from the public segment ledger, derive method-change and segment-boundary gaps independently, and verify the exact 1/3003 combinatorial control.

acceptance.criterion: All seven source segments are homogeneous and the six source boundaries equal all six operation changes across the frozen solved-page sequence.

output.stdout: PASS — 8/8 E156 ledger checks; solved-LP1 boundaries equal operation changes.

controls: Only already-solved LP1 pages and established operators are used.
All 3,003 ways to place six boundaries among fourteen page gaps define the comparison family.
Segment boundaries are taken from the source ledger; method changes are derived separately from the known operation sequence.
interpretation: On solved LP1, the dollar boundary is supported as an operation-scope boundary. This motivates preserving operation state across internal records, but does not identify the operation selector for unsolved segments.
limitations: This is a structural known-control observation on solved LP1, not a new plaintext recovery.
The public package verifies the retained normalized ledger; it does not redistribute the complete third-party LP1 transcription or source imagery.
The result identifies where known operations change, not which unknown operation applies to an LP2 segment.
Transfer of the frame model from LP1 to unsolved LP2 requires separate tests.

normalization_changes: Separated the exact solved-LP1 structural claim from later exploratory E157-E160 leads.
Retained the complete seven-segment operation ledger and result object.
Added a portable independent combinatorial and boundary verifier.
Excluded forward experiment queues and private typed-corpus dependencies.

raw_artifacts.reason: The exact structural ledger and result are public; complete source transcriptions and later experimental queues are excluded.
